exposure: Read corrected extras-blind.html including actual adult prompts, with answer disclosures removed. No extras.py, keys or full pages opened before this save.

criteria.heading: Three complete original text models
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Story entertains through linked loss/help/recovery/thanks/safe ending; information groups accurate shelf and return facts under headings; persuasion politely requests a reading box with a directly relevant convenience reason.

criteria.heading: Sentences and word choices
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: One-clause simple sentence; noun group The small seed tray; whole verb group was resting. Soil sentence has two independent clauses linked by result so; seeds and soil are coordinated objects only. Basket/garden/paper ordinarily two syllables.

criteria.heading: An edit you can explain
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Mila took a seed tray to the garden. She put it on the shelf. Capitalise Mila, replace vague thing, remove duplicate it, add final full stop; preserve meaning/order and clear references.

criteria.heading: Create and edit a simple digital text
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Actually create/revise two ordered digital panels with captions and matching pictures, check edits and save with adult. Paper version does not evidence digital production; supplied correct captions may need another meaningful actual revision.

criteria.heading: Planning cards to sort and use
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: A story/entertain with linked hat recovery ending; B information with accurate window/blue-pencil-pot/paper-box facts grouped under headings; C persuasion with quiet-drawing-corner request, relevant reason and polite trial action.

criteria.heading: A fresh written check
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Heading and a few linked sentences inform new classmate: craft tray beside door, clean brushes red pot, scraps paper box. Learner explains useful precise word or meaningful edit; exact wording may vary.

criteria.heading: Show what you can create
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Actual coherent hat story with helper/recovery/ending and one explained sentence edit; separate polite quiet-drawing-corner request with directly relevant reason. Assess actual texts, recording support.

criteria.heading: Complete original presentation and useful cue
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Actually deliver box talk using Choose/Read/Return cue. Cover-facing-front return and quiet-reading purpose accurate; cue/script are supports, not performance proof.

criteria.heading: Rehearse, listen and improve
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Actual rehearsal and revised delivery with specific change responding to real listener clarity feedback. Observe topic/order/words, audible or accessible message, useful pacing; record supports.

criteria.heading: Two purposes; purposeful delivery
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Actual model/attempt of welcome and calm care reminder; intention/context/listener feedback matter, no universal pitch rule.

criteria.heading: A different presentation to prepare
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Own opening, ordered paper-flat/short-edge-to-short-edge/press/open sequence, clear card ending, cue or demonstration; actual rehearsal, feedback, improvement and second delivery.

criteria.heading: A fresh presentation check
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Accurate art-tray blue-pot pencils/paper-box scraps/window location; opening/points/cue/ending, actual rehearsal, specific clarity question, responsive change and revised delivery.

criteria.heading: A useful reflection
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Reflection references actual listener understanding, actual change with reason and useful next step; does not replace presentation.

criteria.heading: Prepare a real handwriting model
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Real nearby adult-written school unjoined model and observed starts/movements; learner writes without tracing. Comfortable tool/position/individual grip; typed target is not stroke-order evidence.

criteria.heading: Complete handwriting targets
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Actual case comparison Mia/mia, target words and one short sentence: correct letter order/case, recognisable unjoined local forms, word gaps. Supplied spelling appropriately isolates handwriting.

criteria.heading: Check relative size and placement
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Actual a/b/g/B demonstration and a big bag copy: short a body, tall b, g below baseline, capital B different. Word gaps clear, local-script placement; no same-height rule.

criteria.heading: Compare actual attempts over time
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Comparable dated samples in later sessions with readable forms/gaps, reduced hesitation/effort and comfort. Observe movement/grasp where discussed, record supports/conditions; immediate repeat alone is current practice.

criteria.heading: A fresh actual handwriting check
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Actual Tom put a bag on the shelf. after adult model, untraced; correct words/case, recognisable unjoined letters/gaps, one strength and improvement. Observe production for movement claims.

criteria.heading: Make one useful next step
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Concrete strength/target from actual writing; brief model-based practice and use in another word, checking comfort/readability before speed.

criteria.heading: Complete sound-card routine
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Fresh /f/ /r/ /e/ /sh/ four phonemes; cloudy /k/ /l/ /ow/ /d/ happy-final-vowel five phonemes/two syllables. Oral tasks: slip minus first /s/=lip; best minus /s/=bet; tent minus final /t/=ten; clap final /p/ to /m/=clam. Preserve all other sounds/order.

criteria.heading: Build, improve and explain a word chain
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Slam to slim swaps vowel; slim to swim swaps /l/ to /w/. Actual oral steps precede print, then write/reread and locate change; displayed reading alone is not independent oral manipulation.

criteria.heading: Quick-answer checks and fresh oral transfer
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Plan minus /l/=pan; clap first /k/ to /f/=flap; stretch slam to slim to swim, one exact change per step. Oral answer first, then conventional writing/rereading.

criteria.heading: Complete reading and sorting cards
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Vowels green ee, moon/book oo with different sounds, rain ai, play ay, beach/bread ea with different sounds, night igh. Frog/crisp clusters; knee silent k, thumb silent b; raincoat/sunset compounds. Overlapping categories legitimate. Rabbit two syllables with one /b/.

criteria.heading: Map, write and reread
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Rain r|ai|n three sounds; thumb th|u|mb three with no separate b; robot two syllables smoothly joined. Dictation tail=t|ai|l three; bright=b|r|igh|t four; sunhat=s|u|n|h|a|t six, sun+hat. Conventional full spelling and actual reread required.

criteria.heading: Quick-answer checks and transfer
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Bright igh long i; sunhat sun+hat, full conventional word. Actual reading before adult pronunciation. Dictation tail/bright/sunhat should preserve complete taught spelling; note a target already read is not fresh independent transfer.

criteria.heading: Complete word-analysis cards
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Said ai and friend ie short e. Come/have final e does not make preceding vowel long. One/once start /w/ without written w, only/lone long o. Conventional exact spellings, not automatic one+suffix rule.

criteria.heading: Complete related-word and context tasks
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Jumped ed /t/, played ed /d/, wanted ed adds syllable; helpful help+ful, played play+ed, jumping jump+ing, each in suitable sentence. Weather wind short i, toy wind long i; do not replace printed word with synonym.

criteria.heading: Quick answers and a covered spelling turn
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Some (s-o-m-e) short vowel as come in usual pronunciation, not phonetic sum; painted=paint+ed, past with extra syllable. Actual spelling/rereading with models hidden; record any supplied come support, not independent mastery.

criteria.heading: Complete base and affix cards
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Conventional families: helper/helpful/helping; unkind/kindness; friendly/friendship; covering/uncover. Prefix re/un before base; er/ful/ing/ed/ness/ly/ship after. Contextual meanings and conventional words required, not arbitrary card joining.

criteria.heading: Family boundary check
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Play/replay/player share meaningful base play; day only rhymes. Kind/unkind share kind; nice can be semantically similar without sharing that morpheme.

criteria.heading: Quick answers and a new family
criteria.independent_solution_or_criteria: Repack=re+pack, pack again; appropriate sentence such as I will repack my bag. Packer=pack+er, someone who packs. Preserve base spelling, position and meaning, actual writing and reread.
